text_block_list.text:
After finishing training with King Halo,
just as we were about to part ways—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This amount of training just isn't enough!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To prove that I am a first-rate Umamusume,
I cannot simply be like everyone else.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is just everyday training,
one must approach it with twice the effort and passion of anyone else.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time for extra training.
Polish your King even further!
choice_data_list: If you're truly top-class, you have to know when to make a graceful exit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now that's my trainer.
You've got me feeling even more fired up!

"After that, King Halo and I threw ourselves
into training until time was up."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Pushing myself until I ruin my health
can hardly be called first-rate, either..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Always maintain peak condition,
and demonstrate one's full abilities without regret...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Are you trying to tell me that is what matters the most?
"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Then I suppose that makes sense to me too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I will refrain from pushing myself and take a proper rest.
All so that I may remain a first-rate King!

Saying so, King Halo refrained
from doing any extra training.
